description: This source file defines the MapProcessor class, which processes map data structures by executing a series of 'make-in-string' and 'process' sub-operations based on an XML configuration. It is part of the org.apache.ofbiz.minilang.operation package and appears to be central to map-related processing within the minilang component of the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: MapProcessor
classes.description: Main class for processing maps with a series of configured operations, initialized from an XML element.

methods.name: MapProcessor
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the MapProcessor with an XML element, parsing child elements to set up processing steps.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the configured processing steps on input map data, producing results and messages, considering locale and class loader context.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of this MapProcessor instance.
